documents.title: Access control
documents.summary: Access to information and related assets should be governed by rules based on business and information-security requirements.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; verify against an authorized copy of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 before audit use.

documents.title: Identity management
documents.summary: Identity lifecycles should be managed from registration through change and removal so that identities remain controlled and traceable.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; verify against an authorized copy of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 before audit use.

documents.title: Authentication information
documents.summary: Authentication information should be assigned and managed through controlled processes, with users advised how to handle it securely.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; verify against an authorized copy of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 before audit use.

documents.title: Access rights
documents.summary: Access rights should be provisioned, reviewed, changed, and removed according to access-control rules and business needs.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; verify against an authorized copy of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 before audit use.
